title: Reel · HRT myth flip — the 10-year window
caption:
Myth: hormone therapy is just too risky. The 2002 WHI trial's average woman was 63 — a decade past menopause. NAMS 2022 says under 60 or within 10 years, the math is different.
Which myth next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#menopause #perimenopause #hormonetherapy #womenshealth #hrtfacts #midlifewomen

scenes.text: You were told hormone therapy is *too risky*. That warning is from 2002 headlines.

scenes.text: Priya is 52, hasn't slept a full night since March, and everyone has an opinion.
phrases: So she stopped asking anyone, including her doctor.

scenes.text: The trial that scared everyone off studied women a decade past menopause, not women at 52.
phrases: WHI, 2002. Every age pooled into one headline.
The 50-somethings' numbers didn't look like the 70-somethings'.

scenes.text: She wrote two lines in her notes app so she wouldn't freeze in the room.
phrases: Top 2 symptoms + the date of your last period.
Ask out loud: "Am I inside the 10-year window?"
For bone: WHO says 150 min a week plus 2 strength sessions.
